messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem with a package on Github/Bioconductor
parts:
Massimo,

The ComplexHeatmap package is broken. It incorrectly puts a Repository field in its DESCRIPTION. See this discussion:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?utm_medium=email&utm_source=footer#!msg/shiny-discuss/x8pCyHSXzAw/MqNKAJZ3AwAJ

You could try sending a PR to fix that, or editing the file manually on your machine.

-Andy

On Wed, Dec 2, 2015 at 12:12 PM, Massimo <squa...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi All,

I've been trying to update an app on shinyapps.io. The updated app require a new package to work properly. Although I've installed this new package from Github, when I try to  deploy the update I'm getting the following error:

Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'ComplexHeatmap'
  
  The package was installed from an unsupported repository 'Bioconductor'. Only packages installed from
  CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are supported.

A previous version of the package is available from Bioconductor, but even if I install the Bioconductor version the app fails to deploy on shinyapps.io. For the record the app deploys fine on a local shiny server.

Very naively, could it be because in the description file the repository is spelled  'Bioconductor' and not 'BioConductor'?

Thanks in advance for your help.

Best,

Massimo
